sources.entry: Cleo - AI financial assistant chatbot that helps users budget, save, and manage money in a fun, conversational way. #freemium

summary.name: Cleo
summary.one_liner: Cleo is an AI financial assistant chatbot that tracks spending, helps set and meet savings goals, and gives conversational, sometimes blunt, budgeting feedback.
use_cases: getting honest feedback on spending habits
linking bank accounts to manage money
summary.what_it_does: Cleo connects to bank accounts through Plaid, tracks spending, and helps users set and reach financial goals, adjusting as circumstances change. It uses a chat interface with a personality, answering questions anytime and calling out bad spending habits, including a "Roast Me" option mentioned in user reviews. The page describes an AI memory feature that learns about the user over time to personalize conversations. It also advertises a Cleo Card and direct deposit banking, with the card issued by WebBank and direct deposit services provided by Thread Bank.
notable: Chat-based AI assistant with a personality that roasts spending habits
Offers a Cleo Card and direct deposit banking through partner banks
Credit building function, per user reviews
caveats: Cleo is a financial technology company and not an FDIC-insured bank; banking services are provided by Thread Bank and the card by WebBank
Cleo Card is subject to approval and requires a $1 minimum deposit
Credit outcomes vary based on individual behavior and credit profile
Some bank accounts may not be supported by Plaid
